releaseNotes: All visible text block dimensions are saved before every tool switch, so older handlers cannot lose the active block geometry
Saved text block width and height are enforced through canonical CSS variables with important rules across Text, Pen, Marker and Eraser modes
Text controls now render as a sibling directly below the standard options row, avoiding legacy popup click handlers while keeping the same visual position as Pen and Marker options
Legacy floating text option panels and the previous inline bar remain hidden
Automatic cleanup of empty text blocks remains enabled
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
